attributes.action: Mental health awareness mandatory lessons in school signs symptoms help
attributes.additional_details: I want all schools across England Wales and Scotland to have maybe 1 lesson a week to highlight these problems and how you can  safely navigate around them and or see the signs in fellow peers to avoid potential worsening or even worse potential suicides also incorporate drug impact aswell. Also slight insight on medications for mental health and how they work as you are aware sometimes anti depressants make things worse before they get better. I feel kids would be equipped better for future.
